sources.title: moonvit-v2-visual-representations/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Exploring Visual Representations in MoonViT-V2 This repository compares MoonViT-V2 with similarly sized vision backbones on ImageNet-1K using a frozen linear probe and full-parameter fine-tuning. All models are evaluated at 224 × 224 resolution with final-layer patch-token mean pooling.

sources.snippet: The model features a 27-layer MoonViT-V2 visual encoder, and its model weights with a scale of 3 trillion parameters were made publicly available worldwide. The open-sourced Kimi K3 achieved Day 0 Adaptation for the Huawei Ascend Computing Platform upon its initial release.
